source_files_used.dry: unaltered dry signal activity and transient comparison
source_files_used.mixed: single lead source, existing tuning retained; time alignment and EQ from v2
source_files_used.demo: timing, original levels and fair comparison reference

vocal_peak_control_statistics.method: 1 ms stereo least-squares gain relative to driven input; active blocks > -50 dBFS. Approximate limiter gain reduction, includes resampling differences.

master_statistics.method: 1 ms stereo least-squares gain relative to driven input; active blocks > -50 dBFS. Approximate limiter gain reduction, includes resampling differences.

notes: No subjective listening or claim of matching a measured Tory Lanez reference.
No raw/processed vocal stacking; dry is a control reference to avoid phase interference.
Limiter gain statistics approximate 1ms block estimates, not exact internal envelopes.
Master loudness raised after vocal-specific transient control, not by global gain alone.
